name: candlestick
title: Candlestick
description: A live candlestick chart card for json-render chats: open, high, low and close per period, volume, a price axis and a 1D/1W/1M/6M/1Y switch, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   CandlestickCard: candlestickCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: CandlestickCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveCandlestickCard ticker={props.ticker || undefined} range={props.range ?? "1m"} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     CandlestickCard: candlestickLookup

Candles load from /api/candlestick (installed at app/api/candlestick/route.ts), backed by Yahoo Finance's public chart endpoint. No API key needed.
